title: Pivotal indicator
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$, taking values in $\{\pm1\}$. For a coordinate $i$ and sign vector $x$, the pivotal indicator is $1$ if flipping coordinate $i$ changes $f(x)$, and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to $\{\pm1\}$
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n
